import pandas as pd
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression

def task_func(df, target):
    """
    Fit a linear regression model on df using `target` as the response column
    and return the R-squared score on the cleaned input data.

    Parameters
    ----------
    df : pandas.DataFrame
        Input data.
    target : str
        Name of the target column in df.

    Returns
    -------
    float
        R-squared score of the fitted model.
    """
    if not isinstance(df, pd.DataFrame):
        df = pd.DataFrame(df)

    if target not in df.columns:
        raise KeyError(f"Target column {target!r} not found in DataFrame.")

    data = df.copy()

    # Separate features and target
    y = pd.to_numeric(data[target], errors="coerce")
    X = data.drop(columns=[target])

    # Encode non-numeric predictors and preserve missingness as a category
    X = pd.get_dummies(X, drop_first=False, dummy_na=True)

    # Replace infinities and drop rows with any invalid values
    X = X.replace([float("inf"), float("-inf")], pd.NA)
    valid_rows = y.notna() & X.notna().all(axis=1)

    X = X.loc[valid_rows]
    y = y.loc[valid_rows]

    # Not enough data or no usable predictors
    if X.shape[0] < 2 or X.shape[1] == 0:
        return 0.0

    model = LinearRegression()
    model.fit(X, y)

    return float(model.score(X, y))
